newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds stay subdued despite Chicago rally.
newsitem.headline: European feeds stay subdued despite Chicago rally.

text.p: The European meals and feed market remained subdued despite a near limit-up rise in Chicago soymeal futures this afternoon on the back of perceptions of tight supplies, market sources said.

The surge in Chicago did not spark business here. There is no faith in the market as long as the swine fever problems continue in the Netherlands. The tight soybean supplies in the U.S. did not impress European buyers as this is old news and there are some 14 vessels arriving in Europe in June carrying soymeal from South America," one broker said.
Only two nearby trades were reported today.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $286 a tonne fob Amsterdam and Spot Thai tapioca pellets changed hands at 19 marks per 100 kg fob Ghent.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
